adversarialFindings.description: Rewritten Git reference copy initially lost a historically indexed contextual phrase (registrerer historikk), breaking an existing legitimate search expectation.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Restored the searchable concept in the Git summary without changing the search engine or lowering the test oracle; the owner reported 84/84 technology-reference tests passing afterward.

adversarialFindings.description: New and revised browser assertions initially disagreed with the actual disclosure and self-report controls, preventing the intended flows from being exercised.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Changed the orientation assertion to verify the details open state after keyboard activation; aligned both self-report button locators and resulting status copy to the implemented UI; the owner reported 29 relevant E2E PASS plus the corrected final E2E PASS separately.

adversarialFindings.description: The lesson roadmap and beginner explanations have not yet been evaluated with a real first-year learner who has no Git experience; test automation cannot establish comprehension.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as a pilot-evaluation limitation rather than a technical release blocker; M02-M07 are explicitly marked planned, M01 alone is available, and no evidence of learner understanding is claimed.

retrospective.summary: No unresolved P0/P1 defects or concrete blocking findings were identified in this bounded AI source review. Candidate may proceed to normal exact-candidate hosted Final candidate validation; this review does not certify the release, establish human independence, or authorize merge on failed checks.
